news.title: Welcome to Guinea Pig Runaway Together 1.0
news.shortDescription: Early Access is over. Guinea Pig Runaway Together is officially 1.0 — with Forgotten Forest, Race Mode, Voice Chat, Hardcore Mode, a full graphics overhaul, and much more.
news.fullBody:
Early Access is over. Guinea Pig Runaway Together is officially 1.0!

Since our Early Access launch, Guinea Pig Runaway Together has grown significantly through new game modes, expanded content, major visual upgrades, multiplayer improvements, accessibility features, performance optimizations, and countless fixes based on player feedback. Version 1.0 represents the most complete version of the game yet.

THE BIGGEST ADDITIONS SINCE EARLY ACCESS
- Brand-new map: Forgotten Forest
- Race Mode with 1v1, 2v2 and up to 4-player Free-for-All
- Built-in Voice Chat
- Local Co-op
- Hardcore Mode with dedicated leaderboards
- More than 4 hours of new gameplay content
- Major map expansions and redesigns
- Complete graphics and rendering overhaul
- Improved water rendering and water physics
- At least 50% better performance compared to the Early Access launch version
- Standard & Easy Physics Modes
- Colorblind accessibility support
- Major multiplayer & connection improvements
- Improved controller & Steam Deck support
- New tutorial system
- New cosmetics & customization options
- Dozens of gameplay, UI and quality-of-life improvements
- Countless bug fixes

RACE MODE
- Added Race Mode with 1v1, 2v2 and up to 4-player Free-for-All support
- Added competitive races where players or teams must reach the finish before their opponents

NEW WAYS TO PLAY
- Added Local Co-op, allowing two players to play together on the same device
- Added Hardcore Mode, which removes checkpoints for a more challenging experience
- Added a dedicated Hardcore leaderboard
- Added built-in Voice Chat, with an option to fully disable it from Settings

GRAPHICS & RENDERING OVERHAUL
- Reworked major parts of the game's rendering pipeline and lighting systems
- Completely rebuilt the game's visual effects
- Added Screen Space Reflections for real-time reflections
- Added Spectral Ambient Occlusion
- Added Spectral Global Illumination for real-time indirect lighting
- Reworked the shadow system for improved visual quality and performance
- Reworked the volumetric lighting system for improved quality and performance
- Added Eye Adaptation
- Reworked the overall color palette and color grading for a more cinematic look
- Improved overall lighting and visual consistency across the game

PERFORMANCE & OPTIMIZATION
- Achieved at least 50% higher performance compared to the Early Access launch version, despite introducing more advanced real-time rendering features
- Performed a broad optimization pass across gameplay systems and existing code
- Improved CPU, GPU and memory efficiency
- Improved frame-time consistency and reduced stuttering
- Improved performance on lower-end systems and older GPUs
- Completely reworked the Low and Medium graphics presets
- Improved texture memory management
- Optimized shadow rendering and level-of-detail distances
- Improved shader compilation and overall rendering efficiency

WATER OVERHAUL
- Improved overall water rendering quality
- Added a new water physics system with physical gameplay interactions

CONTENT & LEVEL EXPANSION
- Added a brand-new map: Forgotten Forest
- Added new obstacles, gameplay sequences and challenges throughout Forgotten Forest
- Added more than one hour of new gameplay content
- Added new cooperative puzzles, events and environmental challenges
- Added new obstacles focused on player coordination
- Added new hidden easter eggs
- Reworked and expanded multiple existing sections
- Overhauled large portions of the original Early Access map

FLOODED CITY IMPROVEMENTS
- Made major visual improvements throughout Flooded City
- Reworked several gameplay sections and adjusted obstacles based on player feedback
- Reduced the speed of the rolling boulder
- Rebalanced sinking platform timings
- Improved performance throughout the level

PHYSICS & MOVEMENT
- Reworked major parts of the physics system
- Improved balloon movement, rotation and wall running
- Improved interactions with moving platforms
- Improved checkpoint spawning behavior
- Reduced unpredictable physics behavior and rebalanced multiple gameplay sections
- Added Standard and Easy Physics Modes

MULTIPLAYER & NETWORKING
- Significantly improved the peer-to-peer multiplayer system
- Improved overall connection and lobby stability
- Improved connection handling for slower internet connections
- Improved ping and network issue detection
- Improved synchronization between host and clients, including moving platforms and animations
- Improved game-start synchronization, lobby joining and disconnect handling

CAMERA IMPROVEMENTS
- Improved overall camera behavior and responsiveness
- Increased the camera auto-alignment delay, with an option to disable it entirely
- Reworked camera shake for smoother transitions
- Fixed situations where the camera could become unresponsive

ACCESSIBILITY
- Added colorblind support with Protanopia, Deuteranopia and Tritanopia modes
- Added Easy Physics Mode for a more forgiving experience
- Improved text readability, including on smaller displays
- Improved controller and menu navigation
- Added additional gameplay and camera settings

CONTROLLER & STEAM DECK
- Improved overall controller support, menu navigation and virtual cursor behavior
- Added native SteamOS virtual keyboard support
- Fixed several virtual cursor and keyboard issues

TUTORIAL & NEW PLAYER EXPERIENCE
- Added a new tutorial system
- Improved explanations for core mechanics
- Improved early-game UI feedback and overall first-time player experience

CUSTOMIZATION
- Improved the character customization system and added new cosmetic options
- Improved skin and outfit selection, customization UI and navigation
- Fixed overlapping customization tabs

UI & QUALITY OF LIFE
- Improved the overall user interface and menu navigation
- Improved leaderboard interfaces
- Added direct in-game bug reporting and improved the feedback system
- Improved Settings menu behavior
- Fixed incorrect key displays in the Controls menu and incorrect player name display
- Fixed various menu and navigation issues

AUDIO
- Increased overall audio volume
- Fixed audio being quieter than intended on certain devices
- Made various audio balancing improvements

GAMEPLAY BALANCING
- Rebalanced the overall difficulty curve
- Adjusted several difficult gameplay sections
- Made the forest boulder escape more forgiving
- Reduced the Flooded City rolling boulder speed and adjusted sinking platform timings
- Improved several checkpoint locations
- Increased the size and number of bombs during the bomb sequence
- Fine-tuned obstacles throughout the map based on player feedback

BUG FIXES
- Fixed a critical issue that could corrupt save files
- Fixed a rare issue where guinea pigs could appear outside the balloon
- Fixed a very rare issue preventing players from moving when a match started
- Fixed rare sudden disconnections after joining a lobby
- Fixed construction-zone elevators disappearing
- Fixed unexpected FPS drops
- Fixed certain settings not saving correctly, and settings becoming inaccessible after viewing the tutorial
- Fixed the feedback system not functioning correctly
- Fixed cars disappearing from traffic in Hardcore Mode
- Fixed multiple achievement-related issues
- Fixed the launch message not appearing correctly
- Fixed multiple localization issues and incorrect character rendering in some languages
- Fixed various particle, visual effect, camera and UI issues
- Fixed several multiplayer synchronization issues
- Fixed numerous minor gameplay issues

What started as the original Early Access release now includes Forgotten Forest, Race Mode, Local Co-op, Voice Chat, Hardcore Mode, new physics modes, expanded levels, new gameplay content, accessibility features, a completely reworked graphics pipeline, real-time reflections, real-time global illumination, improved water physics, major multiplayer improvements and significantly better performance.

Thank you to everyone who played during Early Access, shared feedback, reported bugs, created videos, played with friends and helped us shape the game into what it is today.

Welcome to Guinea Pig Runaway Together 1.0.

— DVS Interactive

news.title: World Nations Cosmetic Pack Out Now!
news.shortDescription: Show your true colors! Personalize your guinea pig with themed hats and flag backpacks from 20 different countries.
news.fullBody:
Take your guinea pig on an international adventure! With the World Nations Cosmetic Pack, you can personalize your character with themed bucket hats and customized flag backpacks representing 20 different countries.

Whether you're teaming up with friends online or running through challenges solo, wear your flag with pride and style!

news.title: Guinea Pig Runaway Together Supporter Pack
news.shortDescription: Support the development and get exclusive in-game goodies with the Guinea Pig Runaway Together Support Pack.
news.fullBody:
Want to help us keep rolling?

The Guinea Pig Runaway Together Support Pack is now available. It includes exclusive cosmetic items and shows your support for an indie team of three working hard to make the best guinea pig co-op experience possible.

Every purchase goes directly back into development. Thank you for being part of this journey.

news.title: Vegawon's Legacy — Wishlist Now on Steam
news.shortDescription: A new adventure from DVS Interactive. Wishlist Vegawon's Legacy on Steam!
news.fullBody:
While we keep rolling with Guinea Pig Runaway Together, we also have something else brewing.

Vegawon's Legacy is a separate project from DVS Interactive. We are not going anywhere Guinea Pig Runaway Together development continues as planned.

If you are curious, head over to the Steam page and add it to your wishlist. It means a lot to us.
